name: MBKAuthe
tagline: Modern, developer-first authentication & session engine for Node.js and Express
description: MBKAuthe is an open-source authentication package for Node.js and Express, backed by PostgreSQL or SQLite. It handles login, session validation, role/app access checks, optional TOTP 2FA, OAuth login, API token authentication, RFC 8628 CLI device flows, and multi-session management.
author: Muhammad Bin Khalid

keyFeatures.title: Dual-Database Architecture
keyFeatures.description: First-class support for both PostgreSQL (connection pooled) and SQLite (via better-sqlite3 with WAL mode and FIFO mutex). Switch effortlessly with zero code changes.

keyFeatures.title: Robust Session Engine
keyFeatures.description: Encrypted session cookies, automatic database validation, session fixation prevention, and configurable multi-session limits per user.

keyFeatures.title: Granular Role-Based Access (RBAC)
keyFeatures.description: Drop-in middleware helpers (sessVal, roleChk, sessRole, strictSessRole) for superadmin, normaluser, member, and guest role enforcement.

keyFeatures.title: Two-Factor Auth (TOTP)
keyFeatures.description: Time-based One-Time Passwords compatible with Google Authenticator, Authy, and 1Password, featuring trusted device remember periods.

keyFeatures.title: GitHub & Google OAuth
keyFeatures.description: Native GitHub App and Google OAuth2 integration with unified user account linking and shared credential support for microservices.

keyFeatures.title: API Tokens & RFC 8628 CLI Auth
keyFeatures.description: SHA-256 hashed API tokens with read-only/write scopes, plus a browser-based CLI device flow for seamless command-line logins.

securityHighlights.title: PBKDF2 Password Hashing
securityHighlights.description: Cryptographically strong password hashing using Node.js crypto PBKDF2 with unique per-user salts.

securityHighlights.title: Session Fixation Prevention
securityHighlights.description: Session identifiers are rotated and encrypted on authentication to thwart session hijacking.

securityHighlights.title: CSRF & Rate Limiting
securityHighlights.description: Built-in double-submit CSRF cookie validation and IP-level rate limiting on sensitive endpoints.

securityHighlights.title: Multi-Session Auto-Pruning
securityHighlights.description: Configurable maximum concurrent sessions per user (MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER) with automatic eviction of stale logins.

securityHighlights.title: Timing-Safe Comparisons
securityHighlights.description: Constant-time string comparison for secret tokens and API hashes to defeat side-channel attacks.

securityHighlights.title: Strict Cookie Policies
securityHighlights.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and Secure cookie flags configured with cross-subdomain sharing support.
